# Draft:Dynasty Films

----
= Dynasty Films =
Dynasty Films is an American film production company. The company was founded by filmmaker and stunt performer Courtney Chen and focuses on action-driven feature films. In 2025, Dynasty Films completed its debut feature film, When Hearts Brew.
History
Dynasty Films was established by Courtney Chen following her work in the film industry as an actress and stunt performer. The company was formed to develop and produce original feature-length projects with an emphasis on action-driven storytelling and performance-based filmmaking.
In late 2025, Dynasty Films completed principal photography on its first feature film, When Hearts Brew, marking the company’s transition from development into feature production. The project was filmed entirely in Georgia with a locally based cast and crew.
Founder
Courtney Chen is an American producer, director, actress, and stunt performer. Prior to founding Dynasty Films, she worked in the film and television industry on major studio productions.
